sentences.text: Last, the rules that are particular to Florida, and to the animals your customers came to see.
Obey the idle-speed and slow-speed signs, and watch for manatees and sea turtles, especially in shallow water.
Running across a flat and cutting a prop scar destroys the nursery your fishery depends on, and it’s illegal in many areas.
If you work the Keys, know the sanctuary’s rules on anchoring, fishing and discharges.
Collect your used fishing line and recycle it.
Loose line kills birds, turtles and dolphins.
And report spills, injured wildlife and violations to the Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission, at eight eight eight, four zero four, three nine two two.
No sheen, no soap, call the National Response Center.
Food at three and twelve miles.
Type three is a holding tank.
Next time, our last Deck lesson: reports, bridges and running a professional operation.
